scenario: native SDL_GPU paired A/B - deferred system fallback faces (issue #172 phase 2)

alicorn.baseline_subject: perf(startup): add native startup attribution markers and harness
alicorn.prototype_commit: the commit that contains this report (parent edd5a1f)
alicorn.change: Defer the DirectWrite/optional system fallback stack until the first shaping request with an unresolved cluster; no timers, workers or GPU resources deferred. Measurement-only A/B flag --eager-system-fonts and probe --fallback-probe-after-first-frame.
alicorn.branches: prototype and baseline are the same executable; the baseline arm passes --eager-system-fonts and executes the pre-change startup path
alicorn.shipped_default_after_verdict: Eager system fallbacks during startup, as before the prototype. The lazy path is opt-in via --deferred-system-fonts; --fallback-probe-after-first-frame implies it. The capture used the prototype-era inverse switch (prototype default lazy, --eager-system-fonts baseline); code paths are unchanged.

scratchpad.workspace: generated 193-file A/B workspace: 8 project directories x 24 files, one 5,000-line project-01/sample_00.go, README.md
scratchpad.environment: fresh APPDATA/LOCALAPPDATA per launch; SCRATCHPAD_ALICORN_WORKSPACE=<generated workspace>; SCRATCHPAD_ALICORN_SMOKE removed

punks.vendored_alicorn: 75d305e1b2e3e4bf982e5899b5217efe2bad0465 (not used; frontend compiled against this worktree)
punks.build: cargo build -p punks-caliber --release; odin build punks-standalone/odin -collection:alicorn=<this worktree> -collection:alikit=<clone>/vendor/alicorn-kit <accesskit args> -o:speed -out:target/windows-x86_64/release/punks.exe

host.desktop_load: other desktop applications were running; CPU load recorded as 3% at the start and 47% at the end of the series in summary.json

protocol.order: each round launches prototype then baseline on odd rounds and baseline then prototype on even rounds
protocol.warmup: one unmeasured file-cache warmup per arm per app
protocol.warm_state: warm-order only; no reboot, cache purge or page-file control
protocol.probe_suite: 6 paired rounds with --fallback-probe-after-first-frame on both arms
protocol.control: 8 paired rounds with both arms eager (Scratchpad), to separate backend on_start jitter from an arm effect
protocol.replicate: a second independent 12-round Scratchpad series after the first
protocol.markers: host-tick elapsed nanoseconds from the host startup origin; window_shown after SDL_ShowWindow; first_application_submit is a GPU submission, not a visible pixel; first_input_ready is the first completed event pump; deferred_system_fonts_enabled records whether the lazy loader was armed
protocol.memory: working set/private bytes sampled every 10 ms and at the PASS line; GPU Process Memory Dedicated/Shared sampled every 500 ms; runtime requested bytes are allocator requests

counters.reliability: GPU counters occasionally have no instance at a sample (missing values in 2-5 samples per suite); Punks exits immediately after PASS and the 10 ms process sampler missed the settle sample in 6 of 24 launches (7 complete pairs)

artifacts.runner_copy: bench_startup.ps1 (capture-time copy; the current tools/bench_startup.ps1 defaults the paired primary arm to --deferred-system-fonts)
